text:
maria: Morning — planning a small console UI push at 15:30 PT today. Static JS/CSS only, no backend schema changes. Estimated rollout ~15 minutes. Who can own the deploy and run smoke/rollback checks?

tyler: I can own deploy. Builds are done, assets hashed and uploaded to S3. CloudFront distribution already pointed. Plan is: canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%. Will trigger CDN invalidation for changed paths after canary passes.

alia: I can run smoke tests. Will start 5 minutes after canary start. Quick checklist: login, open dashboard, open a few plugin panels, search, and check console for uncaught exceptions.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by tyler at 2024-06-15T22:30:24Z (thread 2167001024) — canary slot reserved. :robot_face:

sre-oncall: I'll monitor infra. Rollback criteria: >1% 5xx across console routes OR p95 latency increase >300ms sustained for 3m. If triggered we roll back to previous artifact and invalidate the new cache. I'll keep a pager open.

tyler: Canary plan details: 5% traffic for 10m, then 50% for 5m, then ramp. If any smoke check fails during canary i'll abort and roll back. Rollback helper script:```\n./scripts/rollback-console.sh --dist-id=E1ABCDEF --previous=console-v257\n```

maria: For CDN/edge concerns — our default cache-control for /static is max-age=24h, but the build pipeline sets `Cache-Control: max-age=300, public` for fingerprinted assets. Still want to run an explicit invalidation for the small set of changed files: `/static/js/app.*.js`, `/static/css/app.*.css`. Use this:```\naws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1ABCDEF --paths "/static/js/app.*.js" "/static/css/app.*.css"\n```

maria: Also running an edge warmup across regions (quick curl) to prime caches after invalidation. Example:```\nregions=("us-east-1" "us-west-2" "eu-west-1")\nfor r in "${regions[@]}"; do\n  curl -I -H "Host: console.redwood.ai" https://edge-proxy-$r.example.com/static/js/app.latest.js || true\ndone\n```

ryan: FYI analytics: new asset name touches the tracking pixel load. I'll watch events for missing pageview pings for the first 30m. If we see >2% drop for 5m we should rollback.

alia: Quick note — I saw a flaky feature test on staging earlier, retriggered CI and it's green now. I'll run the smoke harness once canary is up.

tyler: Kicked the canary at +00:02. Logs show cache headers as expected and ETag changed. Sample log: `GET /static/js/app.abc123.js 200 12ms cache:HIT`

maria: Great. Alia, ping here when smoke checks complete. Sre-oncall, please flag if any infra alert fires. If all good we'll continue ramp at +10m. :thumbsup:

alia: Smoke run complete at +08m — login/search/dashboard all good, no console errors in devtools. Marking canary PASSED.

sre-oncall: No infra alerts, error rate steady at baseline, p95 ok. No rollback.

tyler: Ramping to 50% now. Will watch for next 5m then full.

maria: Thanks team — proceeding with remainder of rollout. If anyone sees an issue call it out and we'll pause and rollback.

ryan: Watching analytics — looks good so far.

tyler: Full rollout complete at +14m. Post-deploy checks passing. Will post a short deploy note to #releases in 10m with artifact id and invalidation id.

maria: Nice work, thanks everyone.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: console-v258 -> stable (2167001189). Artifacts: console-v258, invalidation ID: ID12345EXAMPLE.
